item.title: Hundreds attend California church's workshop on responding to ICE raids
item.description: A theologically liberal California church says that hundreds of people attended its recent workshop on how to respond to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents. #AllSaintsChurch #ICE #Episcopal #liberal #Pasadena #immigration #illegalaliens

item.title: Conservative denomination excommunicates pastor for supporting kinism, white supremacy
item.description: The Reformed Presbyterian Church of North America, a small conservative denomination with just over 7,000 members, has excommunicated one of its ministers for advocating kinism, which teaches that God ordained racial segregation and that people should live, marry and worship only within their own racial or ethnic groups. #Kinism #SamuelKetcham #WhiteSupremacy

item.title: Legendary football coach Lou Holtz enters hospice
item.description: Legendary college football coach Lou Holtz, best known for coaching Notre Dame’s Fighting Irish to a national championship during his three-decade coaching career, has entered hospice care. #LouHoltz #UniversityofNotreDame #Football #DonaldTrump

item.title: Hillary Clinton likens Trump to Nero, attacks Douglas Wilson as 'Christian nationalist'
item.description: Former Secretary of State and 2016 Democratic presidential nominee Hillary Clinton penned an article in The Atlantic this week accusing Trump supporters of waging a war on "empathy," and singled out Idaho-based Pastor Douglas Wilson for particular attack. #HillaryClinton #DouglasWilson #ICE #DonaldTrump #immigration #TheAtlantic

item.title: Teenage Chick-fil-A worker brings fellow 'American Idol' hopeful to tears by performing her original song
item.description: A teenage Chick-fil-A employee who auditioned for “American Idol” by singing a cover of the song “Honest” didn’t realize the songwriter was next in line behind her, waiting to audition. Hearing the teen's rendition of her original song brought the songwriter to tears. #AmericanIdol #ChickfilA #LaineyGrace #realitytelevision

item.title: Trump's week in review: Trump Accounts for kids, abortion pill lawsuit intervention
item.description: This week saw multiple developments in both fiscal and social policy in the United States. Among them, President Donald Trump unveiled an initiative to give a $1,000 investment to babies born in the next three years, and announced his pick to lead the Federal Reserve. Here are five highlights from this week. #Abortion #Trump #TrumpAccounts #FederalReserve #KevinWarsh

item.title: Winter in Helsinki: A European capital without the crowds
item.description: Finland’s capital is often overlooked in winter, when many travelers assume darkness and cold outweigh the rewards. That assumption doesn’t hold. #Helsinki #Finland #UspenskiCathedral

item.title: This week in Christian history: Answers in Genesis sues Kentucky; the first Bonfire of the Vanities
item.description: Events that occurred this week in Christian history include the first official "bonfire of the vanities," Answers in Genesis suing Kentucky and a bishop setting up a mission in the Congo. #bonfireofthevanities #AnswersinGenesis #Kentucky #history #Congo #Methodism

item.title: Fewer pastors now feel like quitting, study finds
item.description: The share of pastors who feel like quitting their jobs is showing a significant decline since the throes of the COVID-19 pandemic, according to new data from Barna Research. #Pastors #quitting #Barna #ministry #churches

item.title: Taliban legalizes slavery, steps up suppression of women and girls: ‘Slide farther backwards’
item.description: The Taliban has codified slavery and formalized a class-based justice system in Afghanistan through a newly approved criminal procedure code signed by its supreme leader, Hibatullah Akhundzada. Legal experts and international rights groups say the new law strips away due process and institutionalizes privilege based on gender, religion and social status. #Taliban #Slavery #ClassBasedJusticeSystem #Afghanistan #CriminalProcedureCode #HibatullahAkhundzada #Gender #Religion #SocialStatus #GordonBro
